# X-Center ID SDK

These npm archives are unmodified packages from [X-Center ID SDK revision 57c4930](https://github.com/Xarber/xcenter-id-sdk/tree/57c4930abe34003dfb74923ec823ef6245a985ce).
Upstream distributes source and documents packaging the Node and browser SDKs
together. The lockfile records the integrity of each archive. The SDK is
AGPL-3.0-only. To update, check out the reviewed SDK commit and run
`npm pack ./packages/client ./packages/server ./packages/web` from that
checkout. Install the three resulting archives together and verify the new lockfile.
